answer: Watch the score fall while nothing lands. Each epoch the node recomputes an identity's credit from the last ninety days of verified work, cuts it for every silent window, and charges a failed claim twice. A shop that ships a falcon crate, timber beams and crystal lenses on schedule holds its score. A farm keeping ten thousand quiet accounts has to keep each one proving work to stay above the payout floor, so the bill reaches the operator before a single token moves.
